brief: Builds a static web bundle that emulates a delivery plan, each part of the solution rendering its own app, with no server needed.
detail: From a stzDelivery it writes index.html, the web assets, one app page per mobile part, the plan-derived engine map, the app data of a stzAppTopology and a manifest. With the engine on, each mobile part also gets its own wasm subset of the Softanza engine, built with Zig and shared between parts that need the same subset; CompileEngine(0) skips that for a fast, toolchain-free build. The bundle folder is the same tree that a deployment can ship with AttachBundle. Build writes files: point SetOutDir at a scratch folder.
receiver:
oD = new stzDelivery("bistro")
oD.AddBackend(:api, :LinuxServer)
o1 = new stzEmulator(oD)
o1.SetOutDir("emu_demo_unused")
